title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 113 ]

blocks.text: Recently new building codes came into effect in our city. All new houses must now be built with proper building materials so that heat will not escape unnecessarily during the winter. The laws have had a definite effect. There has been a fifty percent saving in the amount of natural gas and electricity used. The city is doing other things to save energy. Buses, partly supported by the city, transport many people throughout the area. Many new bicycle paths were made, and today there are twice as many bicycles as cars in the city.

readingSentences.english: Recently new building codes came into effect in our city.
readingSentences.korean: 최근에 새로운 건축 규약이 우리 시에서 시행되었다.

readingSentences.english: All new houses must now be built with proper building materials so that heat will not escape unnecessarily during the winter.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 새로운 주택들은 겨울철에 열이 불필요하게 빠져나가지 않도록 적절한 건축 재료로 지어져야만 한다.

readingSentences.english: The laws have had a definite effect.
There has been a fifty percent saving in the amount of natural gas and electricity used.
The city is doing other things to save energy.
readingSentences.korean: 시는 에너지 절약을 위해서 다른 일도 하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Buses, partly supported by the city, transport many people throughout the area.
readingSentences.korean: 부분적으로 시의 지원을 받는 버스는 지역 전체에 많은 사람들을 운송하고 있다.

readingSentences.english: Many new bicycle paths were made, and today there are twice as many bicycles as cars in the city.
readingSentences.korean: 많은 새로운 자전거 도로가 만들어졌으며, 오늘날 시에는 자동차의 두 배만큼 많은 자전거가 있다.
